analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 중립 구간 42.7~42.8 유지, MACD 히스토그램은 약세수렴 지속 중 개선세 확인. 5일 저가 95,920원, 20일 저가 82,500원으로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 변동성 ATR 8.51% 대비 현재가 11.54% 상승은 긍정적이나, SMA5 100,153원, SMA20 103,660원 등 단기 이동평균선 저항 구간 진입.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in the neutral zone between 42.7-42.8, while MACD histogram shows improvement amidst continued weak convergence. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 95,920 and the 20-day low at 82,500. While the current price increase of 11.54% relative to ATR of 8.51% is positive, the price is entering resistance zones around short-term moving averages like SMA5 at 100,153 and SMA20 at 103,660.
